thesis: The page is the visit log: every section is a timestamped entry on a clipboard, and the signature is the waterline tile that draws down the margin as each step checks off.

signature.name: Waterline Visit Log
signature.summary: A thin cobalt waterline rule runs down the left margin like pool tile seen from the side; every section is a timestamped log entry (08:02 Skim, 08:09 Brush…). A sticky visit card fills in as you scroll, ending with a completed sample report. Waterline draws via --sw-p clip-path wipe; log lines type in with stagger.

motion.intro: Waterline draws down left margin with gentle ripple ease; first timestamp ticks in. ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Log lines type into sticky visit card with check marks on scroll entry, 60ms stagger
Waterline advances via --sw-p clip-path wipe synced to scroll progress
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on links and buttons, 200ms ease-out
